result.title: See what changed and what proves it works
result.objective: Read the outcome and its evidence directly on each change page.

suggestedSlices.title: Put outcomes and evidence first on change pages
acceptance: Change pages show scoped evidence and artifacts first, distinguish historical observations, and associate only commits with an exact matching turn trailer. Previously completed workstreams with stale prerequisites are clearly labeled as historical completion needing revalidation.

Previously completed workstreams are audited against current code and behavioral evidence; missing acceptance mappings are retrofitted only where tests support them, with current change-aware verification and explicit residual gaps.

postSealAmends.summary: Finish the audit with exhaustive validated coverage and independently reviewed judgments; fix the reported source highlighting case.
